summary: The weighted unit-step inequality and determinant corollary withstand manual algebraic review, with the Amos bound valid on the full stated real-order domain. The contribution is a compact, potentially novel special-function lemma of narrow demonstrated scope. The paper correctly leaves signed-sum positivity open and claims no four-dimensional result. Minor revisions should correct two reference authorships, qualify numerical precision/proof-method assertions, document immutable code and numerical parameters, and justify convergence. Printed Lean claims were not replayed.
